title: Quality Assurance Specialist & Safety Coordinator
company: Chocolat Alprose SA / Comod Trading SA

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di Quality Assurance Specialist & Safety Coordinator di Chocolat Alprose, supporti le attività quotidiane del nostro reparto di Quality Assurance e garantisci che tutti i prodotti fabbricati nel nostro sito Caslano soddisfino i più elevati standard di qualità, igiene e sicurezza del lavoro.
In qualità di Quality Assurance Specialist & Safety Coordinator di Chocolat Alprose, supporti le attività quotidiane del nostro reparto di Quality Assurance e garantisci che tutti i prodotti fabbricati nel nostro sito Caslano soddisfino i più elevati standard di qualità, igiene e sicurezza del lavoro. Con una mentalità strutturata e analitica, si lavora a stretto contatto con il Capo della Qualità e collabora con la Produzione e altri dipartimenti per mantenere e migliorare continuamente il nostro Sistema di Gestione della Qualità e le nostre condizioni di sicurezza. Si gioca un ruolo operativo e interfunzionale, mantenendo una forte presenza nelle aree di produzione e assicurando che le procedure, le buone pratiche di produzione e i requisiti di sicurezza siano applicati in modo coerente Circa l'80% del ruolo è dedicato alle attività di qualità, mentre il restante 20% si concentra sulle responsabilità di sicurezza.

## Le tue responsabilità in qualità di Quality Assurance Specialist & Safety Coordinator di Alprose
- Sostenere il mantenimento del Sistema di Gestione della Qualità e garantire il rispetto delle procedure interne e degli standard di sicurezza alimentare.
- Applicazione e aggiornamento di procedure, istruzioni operative e documentazione di qualità.
- Condurre controlli e verifiche nelle aree di produzione secondo le procedure aziendali.
- Segnalare tempestivamente deviazioni e non conformità e sostenere la loro indagine.
- Sostenere la gestione dei reclami dei clienti raccogliendo informazioni, analizzando cause e monitorando azioni correttive.
- Collaborare in audit interni ed esterni, inclusi i controlli del cliente e del corpo di certificazione.
- Monitoraggio delle azioni correttive e preventive e garanzia della loro effettiva attuazione.
- Promuovere la qualità e la cultura della sicurezza alimentare attraverso il supporto formativo e la comunicazione quotidiana.
- Preparazione di report e documentazione relativi ai controlli di qualità, non conformità, reclami e audit.

## Che cosa si porta come Quality Assurance Specialist & Safety Coordinator di Alprose
- Una laurea rilevante in Scienze e Tecnologie Alimentari, Biologia, Chimica o discipline scientifiche simili.
- Esperienza nell'assicurazione della qualità o nel controllo della qualità nell'industria alimentare.
- Una mentalità strutturata, analitica e dettagliata.
- Un interesse intrinseco per gli standard e le condizioni di sicurezza.
- Forte capacità di comunicazione e la capacità di collaborare efficacemente con i team di produzione.
- Un atteggiamento proattivo e la volontà di lavorare nell'ambiente di produzione.
- Capacità di gestire più attività con precisione e affidabilità.
- Ottimo comando di inglese e italiano; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.

## Cosa offriamo come Quality Assurance Specialist & Safety Coordinator di Alprose
- Un ambiente di lavoro motivante con compiti impegnativi e varie.
- Opportunità di collaborare con le funzioni centrali di Qualità e con i partner esterni.
- Opportunità di sviluppo professionali all'interno del gruppo.
- Un team dinamico e solidale impegnato in qualità e sicurezza.

## Lavorare a Alprose
Nella nostra struttura Caslano produciamo ogni giorno una vasta gamma di prodotti di cioccolato, dal cioccolato liquido alle compresse e ai prodotti rivestiti. Il sito combina competenze di lunga data con tecnologie affidabili, supportate da un team motivato impegnato nella qualità.
Desideroso di guidare il nostro sito di produzione e contribuire al futuro sviluppo di Alprose? Applicare ora tramite il modulo sottostante!
descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Quality Assurance Specialist & Safety Coordinator at Chocolat Alprose, you support the daily activities of our Quality Assurance department and ensure that all products manufactured at our Caslano site meet the highest standards of quality, hygiene and work safety.
As a Quality Assurance Specialist & Safety Coordinator at Chocolat Alprose, you support the daily activities of our Quality Assurance department and ensure that all products manufactured at our Caslano site meet the highest standards of quality, hygiene and work safety. With a structured and analytical mindset, you work closely with the Head of Quality and collaborate with Production and other departments to maintain and continuously improve our Quality Management System and our safety conditions. You play an operational and cross‑functional role, maintaining a strong presence in the production areas and ensuring that procedures, good manufacturing practices and safety requirements are consistently applied Approximately 80% of the role is dedicated to quality activities, while the remaining 20% focuses on safety responsibilities.

## Your responsibilities as Quality Assurance Specialist & Safety Coordinator at Alprose
- Supporting the maintenance of the Quality Management System and ensuring compliance with internal procedures and food safety standards.
- Applying and updating procedures, operational instructions and quality documentation.
- Conducting checks and verifications in production areas according to company procedures.
- Reporting deviations and non‑conformities promptly and supporting their investigation.
- Supporting customer complaint management by collecting information, analysing causes and monitoring corrective actions.
- Collaborating in internal and external audits, including customer and certification body audits.
- Monitoring corrective and preventive actions and ensuring their effective implementation.
- Promoting quality and food safety culture through training support and daily communication.
- Preparing reports and documentation related to quality controls, non‑conformities, complaints and audits.

## What you bring as Quality Assurance Specialist & Safety Coordinator at Alprose
- A relevant degree in Food Science and Technology, Biology, Chemistry or similar scientific disciplines.
- Experience in Quality Assurance or Quality Control within the food industry.
- A structured, analytical and detail‑oriented mindset.
- An intrinsic interest in safety standards and conditions.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with production teams.
- A proactive attitude and willingness to work in the production environment.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks with accuracy and reliability.
- Excellent command of English and Italian; additional languages are an advantage.

## What we offer as Quality Assurance Specialist & Safety Coordinator at Alprose
- A motivating work environment with challenging and varied tasks.
- Opportunities to collaborate with central Quality functions and external partners.
- Professional development opportunities within the group.
- A dynamic and supportive team committed to quality and safety.

## Working at Alprose
At our Caslano facility, we produce a wide range of chocolate products every day, from liquid chocolate to tablets and coated products. The site combines long‑standing expertise with reliable technologies, supported by a motivated team committed to quality.
Eager to lead our production site and contribute to the future development of Alprose? Apply now via the form below!

descriptionByLocale.en:
As the Plant Manager of Chocolat Alprose, you oversee and coordinate the daily operations of our production site in Caslano. With strong leadership skills and guided by our code of conduct, you act as a role model and motivate your team to achieve the production and quality targets of the company.
You empower people to excel, ensuring that all safety measures are consistently followed. Your area of responsibility covers around 60 employees working in production, supply chain, quality assurance, technical services and product management. In a dynamic chocolate manufacturing environment, processes evolve constantly. You easily adapt to changes, maintain an open mindset and proactively look for opportunities to improve quality, efficiency and stability across production lines. You collaborate with other plant managers within the group and contribute to business development, supporting the evolution of the site’s core competencies, including special productions and product innovation.

## Your responsibilities as Plant Manager at Alprose
- Ensuring efficient and stable production through pragmatic daily solutions and forward‑looking strategic planning.
- Defining clear processes and a transparent flow of information across departments.
- Fostering a positive team atmosphere, effective communication and strong on‑site presence.
- Initiating and managing the optimization of the site, production lines and processes with a hands‑on approach and technical knowledge.
- Managing based on KPIs and developing the site economically in close cooperation with company management.

## What you bring as Plant Manager at Alprose
- Several years of experience managing a production plant or manufacturing unit, ideally in the food industry.
- A hands‑on mentality, adaptive and open mindset combined with strategic thinking and technical expertise.
- An empathetic and determined personality, with the courage to challenge and improve existing processes.
- Excellent business and leadership skills.
- Excellent command of English and Italian; additional languages are an advantage.

## What we offer as Plant Manager at Alprose
- A permanent employment contract.
- A motivating work environment with challenging and varied tasks.
- Opportunities to collaborate internationally within the group.
- Creative freedom to explore new product ideas and solutions.
- Professional development opportunities at group level.

## Working at Alprose
At our Caslano facility, we produce a wide range of chocolate products every day from liquid chocolate to tablets and coated products. The site combines long‑standing expertise with reliable technologies, supported by a motivated team committed to quality.
Eager to lead our production site and contribute to the future development of Alprose? Apply now via the form below!
